report.summary: The fix is correct: when an issue tool's input struct has no fields (list_issue_labels once projectId is removed), tools/list now returns an explicit object schema instead of Effect's {"not":{"type":"null"}}. All other tools still use Effect's Draft-07 output. The new test decodes tools/list both without a run and in a review run, and fails if any tool's inputSchema.type is missing or is not "object", so it is a real regression test. The only problem is a misplaced doc comment, which is not blocking. Typecheck and tests were not run because the read-only sandbox needed approval for those commands.

findings.text: toolInputSchema was inserted between handleMcpMessage's doc comment ("Handles one JSON-RPC message; returns the response, or null for a notification.") and the function it documents. That comment now sits above toolInputSchema, and handleMcpMessage has none. Move the helper above that comment.

args.command: git log --oneline -3 && sed -n 200,320p packages/tempod/src/tempo-mcp.ts && grep -n "inputSchema\|toJsonSchema\|Schema.Struct({})\|list_issue_labels" -r packages/tempod/src packages/protocol/src | head -40

sed -n 80,110p packages/protocol/src/issue-tools.ts; grep -n "input:" packages/protocol/src/issue-tools.ts | head; grep -n "review" packages/protocol/src/*.ts | grep -i outputkind | head -3; cd packages/tempod && timeout 200 npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -5

sed -n 80,110p packages/protocol/src/issue-tools.ts; grep -n "input:\|interface\|type IssueTool" packages/protocol/src/issue-tools.ts | head -20; grep -rn "OutputKind = " packages/protocol/src | head -3
